stem: Two lighting setups use different fixtures but produce similar canopy-level photon exposure over the same photoperiod. Which conclusion is most scientifically defensible?
choices: Fixture label alone is insufficient; intensity, spectrum, photoperiod and canopy distribution should be evaluated together
The more expensive fixture must produce the better biological response
Fixture wattage alone determines plant response regardless of spectrum or distribution
Photoperiod can be ignored whenever measured intensity is similar
rationale: Cannabis photobiology is influenced by interacting light intensity, spectrum and photoperiod, while fixture characteristics also affect spatial distribution at the canopy.
